method.description: Individually inspected chronological overview sheet of 12 evenly spaced frames plus denser sheets sampling every fourth frame and final frame. Compared against previously visually inspected exact-hash source. Metadata verified with ffprobe. No realtime playback claimed.

observations: Single penguin, yellow/purple hat, red scarf, turquoise/orange fish and blue ice floe remain stable and recognizable across samples.

Penguin raises and alternates its two flippers, sways and lifts alternating feet in a cheerful dance. Beak opens and eyes become happy closed arcs; these read as expression changes rather than identity loss.
Scarf follows the body, feet remain coherent, and the fish stays beside the penguin. No duplicated limbs, object disappearance or obvious morphing appears in the sampled sequence.
Motion is clearly active and playful rather than a static hold; main palette, bold outlines and composition are preserved.
limitations: Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of every inter-sample artifact or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
